H2100.def: a primitive root; to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow:--flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.

H2101.def: from «02100»; a seminal or menstrual flux:--issue.

H2102.def: or (by permutation) ziyd {zeed}; a primitive root; to seethe; figuratively, to be insolent:--be proud, deal proudly, &Š presume, (come) presumptuously, sod.

H2103.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02102»; to be proud:--in pride.

H2104.def: plural probably from the same as «02123»; prominent; Zuzites, an aboriginal tribe of Palestine:--Zuzims.

H2105.def: of uncertain origin; Zocheth, an Israelite:--Zoheth.

H2106.et: apparently from the same root as (02099) (in the sense of prominence)
H2106.def: apparently from the same root as «02099» (in the sense of prominence); an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta):--corner(stone).

H2107.def: a primitive root (compare «02151»); probably to shake out, i.e. (by implication) to scatter profusely; figuratively, to treat lightly:--lavish, despise.

H2108.def: from «02107»; probably scattering, i.e. removal; used adverbially, except:--beside, but, only, save.

H2109.def: a primitive root; perhaps properly, to be plump, i.e. (transitively) to nourish:--feed.

H2111.def: a primitive root; properly, to shake off, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (as with fear):--move, tremble, vex.

H2113.def: from «02111»; agitation, fear:--be removed, trouble, vexation. Compare «02189».

H2114.def: a primitive root; to turn aside (especially for lodging); hence to be a foreigner, strange, profane; specifically (active participle) to commit adultery:--(come from) another (man, place), fanner, go away, (e-)strange(-r, thing, woman).

H2115.def: a primitive root (compare «06695»); to press together, &Š tighten:--close, rush, thrust together.

H2116.def: from «02115»; trodden on:--that which is crushed.

H2117.def: probably from the root of «02123»; prominent; Zaza, an Israelite:--Zaza.

H2118.def: a primitive root; to shove or displace:--loose.

H2119.def: a primitive root; to crawl; by implication, to fear:--be afraid, serpent, worm.

H2120.def: feminine active participle of «02119»; crawling (i.e. serpent); Zocheleth, a boundary stone in. Palestine:--Zoheleth.

H2121.def: from «02102»; boiling of water, i.e. wave:--proud.

H2123.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to be conspicuous
H2123.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to be conspicuous; fulness of the breast; also a moving creature:--abundance, wild beast.

H2124.def: apparently from the same as «02123»; prominence; Ziza, the name of two Israelites:--Ziza.

H2125.def: another form for «02124»; Zizah, an Israelite:--Zizah.

H2126.def: from «02109»; well-fed; or perhaps an orthographical error for «02124»; Zina, an Israelite:--Zina.

H2128.def: from the same as «02203»; flowing; Ziph, the name of a place in Palestine; also of an Israelite:--Ziph.

H2129.def: feminine of «02128»; a flowing; Ziphah, an Israelite:--Ziphah.

H2130.def: patrial from «02128»; a Ziphite or inhabitant of Ziph:--Ziphim, Ziphite.

H2131.def: (Isa. «050»: (feminine); and ziq {zeek}; or zeq {zake}; from «02187»; properly, what leaps forth, i.e. flash of fire, or a burning arrow; also (from the original sense of the root) a bond:--chain, fetter, firebrand, spark.

H2132.et: probably from an unused root [akin to (02099)]
H2132.def: probably from an unused root (akin to «02099»); an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry:--olive (tree, -yard), Olivet.

H2133.def: from «02132»; olive grove; Zethan, an Israelite:--Zethan.

H2135.et: a primitive root [compare (02141)]; to be translucent
H2135.def: a primitive root (compare «02141»); to be translucent; figuratively, to be innocent:--be (make) clean, cleanse, be clear, count pure.

H2136.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02135»; purity:--innocency.

H2138.et: properly, pass. participle of (02142), but used for (2145)
H2138.def: properly, passive participle of «02142», but used for «02145»; a male (of man or animals):--males, men-children.

H2139.def: from «02142»; mindful; Zakkur, the name of seven Israelites:--Zaccur, Zacchur.

H2141.def: a primitive root (compare «02135»); to be transparent or clean (phys. or morally):--be (make) clean, be pure(-r).

H2142.def: a primitive root; properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; also (as denominative from «02145») to be male:--X burn (incense), × earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, × still, think on, × well.

H2143.def: or zeker {zeh'-ker}; from «02142»; a memento, abstr. recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration:--memorial, memory, remembrance, scent.

H2144.def: the same as «02143»; Zeker, an Israelite:--Zeker.

H2145.def: from «02142»; properly, remembered, i.e. a male (of man or animals, as being the most noteworthy sex):--X him, male, man(child, -kind).

H2146.def: from «02142»; a memento (or memorable thing, day or writing):--memorial, record.

H2147.def: from «02142»; memorable; Zicri, the name of twelve Israelites:--Zichri.

H2148.def: or Zkaryahuw {zek-ar-yaw'-hoo}; from «02142» and «03050»; Jah has remembered; Zecarjah, the name of twenty-nine Israelites:--Zachariah, Zechariah.

H2149.def: from «02151»; properly, a shaking, i.e. perhaps a tempest:--vilest.

H2150.def: by reduplication from «02151»; tremulous, i.e. a twig:--sprig.

H2151.def: a primitive root (compare «02107»); to shake (as in the wind), i.e. to quake; figuratively, to be loose morally, worthless or prodigal:--blow down, glutton, riotous (eater), vile.

H2152.def: or ziliaphaph {zil-aw-faw'}; from «02196»; a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming):--horrible, horror, terrible.

H2153.et: from an unused root apparently mean to trickle, as myrrh
H2153.def: : from an unused root apparently meaning to trickle, as myrrh; fragrant dropping; Zilpah, Leah's maid:--Zilpah.

H2154.def: or zammah {zam-maw'}; from «02161»; a plan, especially a bad one:--heinous crime, lewd(-ly, -ness), mischief, purpose, thought, wicked (device, mind, -ness).

H2155.def: the same as «02154»; Zimmah, the name of two Israelites:--Zimmah.

H2156.def: or zmorah {zem-o-raw'} (feminine); and zmor {zem-ore'} (masculine); from «02168»; a twig (as pruned):--vine, branch, slip.

H2157.def: from «02161»; intriguing; a Zamzumite, or native tribe of Palestine:--Zamzummim.

H2158.def: or zamir {zaw-meer'}; and (feminine) zmirah {zem-ee-raw'}; from «02167»; a song to be accompanied with instrumental music:--psalm(-ist), singing, song.

H2160.def: feminine of «02158»; song; Zemirah, an Israelite:--Zemira.

H2161.def: a primitive root; to plan, usually in a bad sense:--consider, devise, imagine, plot, purpose, think (evil).

H2163.def: a primitive root; to fix (a time):--appoint.

H2164.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02163»; to agree (on a time and place):--prepare.

H2167.et: a primitive root [perhaps ident. with (02168) through the idea of striking with the fingers]
H2167.def: a primitive root (perhaps ident. with «02168» through the idea of striking with the fingers); properly, to touch the strings or parts of a musical instrument, i.e. play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music:--give praise, sing forth praises, psalms.

H2168.def: a primitive root (compare «02167», «05568», «06785»); to trim (a vine):--prune.

H2169.def: apparently from «02167» or «02168»; a gazelle (from its lightly touching the ground):--chamois.

H2170.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02167»; instrumental music:--musick.

H2171.def: (Aramaic) from the same as «02170»; an instrumental musician:--singer.

H2172.def: from «02167»; a musical piece or song to be accompanied by an instrument:--melody, psalm.

H2174.def: from «02167»; musical; Zimri, the name of five Israelites, and of an Arabian tribe:--Zimri.

H2175.def: from «02167»; musical; Zimran, a son of Abraham by Keturah:--Zimran.

H2176.def: from «02167»; instrumental music; by implication, praise:--song.

H2177.def: from «02109»; properly, nourished (or fully developed), i.e. a form or sort:--divers kinds, × all manner of store.

H2179.et: a primitive root meaning to wag; used only as a denominative from (02180)
H2179.def: a primitive root meaning to wag; used only as a denominative from «02180»; to curtail, i.e. cut off the rear:--smite the hindmost.

H2180.et: from (02179) (in the original sense of flapping)
H2180.def: from «02179» (in the original sense of flapping); the tail (literally or figuratively):--tail.

H2181.et: a primitive root [highly-fed and therefore wanton]
H2181.def: a primitive root (highly-fed and therefore wanton); to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple fornication, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively, to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah):--(cause to) commit fornication, × continually, × great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause to be, play the) whore, (commit, fall to) whoredom, (cause to) go a-whoring, whorish.

H2182.def: from «02186»; rejected; Zanoach, the name of two places in Palestine:--Zanoah.

H2185.et: regarded by some as if from (02109) or an unused root, and applied to military equipments
H2185.def: regarded by some as if from «02109» or an unused root, and applied to military equipments; but evidently the feminine plural active participle of «02181»; harlots:--armour.

H2186.et: a primitive root meaning to push aside
H2186.def: a primitive root meaning to push aside, i.e. reject, forsake, fail:--cast away (off), remove far away (off).

H2187.def: a primitive root; properly, to draw together the feet (as an animal about to dart upon its prey), i.e. to spring forward:-- leap.

H2189.def: by transposition for «02113»; agitation, maltreatment:--X removed, trouble.

H2191.et: from an unused root [akin (by permutation) to (06819)], meaning to dwindle
H2191.def: from an unused root (akin (by permutation) to «06819»), meaning to dwindle; small:--little.

H2193.def: a primitive root; to extinguish:--be extinct.

H2194.def: a primitive root; properly, to foam at the mouth, i.e. to be enraged:--abhor, abominable, (be) angry, defy, (have) indignation.

H2195.def: from «02194»; strictly froth at the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) fury (especially of God's displeasure with sin):--angry, indignation, rage.

H2196.def: a primitive root; properly, to boil up, i.e. (figuratively) to be peevish or angry:--fret, sad, worse liking, be wroth.

H2199.def: a primitive root; to shriek (from anguish or danger); by analogy, (as a herald) to announce or convene publicly:-- assemble, call (together), (make a) cry (out), come with such a company, gather (together), cause to be proclaimed.
